preview.text: Singapore won the toss and chose to bat first against Maldives in a T20 match at Selangor Turf Club. The usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches at Selangor Turf Club is 144. The forecast for the next 8 hours calls for up to a 78 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees.

summary.text: Singapore won by 33 runs after scoring 188 for 6, featuring a top score of 105 off 61 balls by Surendran Chandramohan, while Harsha Amarasinghe took 2 for 37. MDV managed 79 for 3 in response, with Ismail Ali top-scoring with 37 off 13 balls and Daksh Pratap Singh Tyagi claiming 1 for 10. The usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches at Selangor Turf Club is 144.
